subject: general
question:
This question is based on the following three letter words.

RAT DOT FRY CUT

If in each of the above words, each letter is changed to its next letter in the English alphabetical order, then how many words thus formed will have no vowel?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7d12502c2ca7d9724c6b72807e815218baf7d8f4c343b106b5314067691645b.png] 

Now, Each letter is changed to its next letter:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0325f5e96297b757de97c141d8fb53ec0c91dc7c420efe8cf0b91dfad804db0e.png] 

Here, there is only one word that has no vowel i.e., GSZ.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
